containerDefinitions.name: infinityai-engine-c
command: pip install fastapi uvicorn requests pydantic && python -c "from fastapi import FastAPI; import uvicorn; app = FastAPI(); @app.get('/health'); def health(): return {'status': 'healthy', 'engine': 'trade_execution', 'version': '2.0.0'}; @app.get('/engine-c/health'); def engine_health(): return {'status': 'healthy', 'engine': 'trade_execution', 'version': '2.0.0'}; uvicorn.run(app, host='0.0.0.0', port=8000)"
